function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/barcode_driver.c <<'C'
#include "allheaders.h"
#include "readbarcode.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
void __sanitizer_cov_trace_pc_guard(uint32_t *guard) {(void)guard;}
void __sanitizer_cov_trace_pc_guard_init(uint32_t *start, uint32_t *stop) {(void)start; (void)stop;}
int main(int argc,char**argv){
 if(argc<2)return 2; size_t sz; l_uint8 *data=l_binaryRead(argv[1],&sz);
 if(!data){puts("no data");return 3;}
 PIX *pixs=pixReadMemSpix(data,sz); LEPT_FREE(data);
 if(!pixs){puts("no pix");return 4;}
 fprintf(stderr,"pix %dx%dx%d\n", pixGetWidth(pixs), pixGetHeight(pixs), pixGetDepth(pixs));
 SARRAY *saw=NULL; SARRAY *sad=pixProcessBarcodes(pixs,L_BF_ANY,L_USE_WIDTHS,&saw,1);
 fprintf(stderr,"sad=%p saw=%p\n",(void*)sad,(void*)saw);
 if (saw) sarrayWriteStream(stderr, saw); if (sad) sarrayWriteStream(stderr, sad);
 pixDestroy(&pixs); sarrayDestroy(&saw); sarrayDestroy(&sad); return 0;
}
C


gcc -no-pie -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -I repo-vul/work-vul/include/leptonica /tmp/barcode_driver.c repo-vul/work-vul/lib/liblept.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libtiff.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libwebp.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libwebpmux.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libwebpdemux.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libpng16.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libjpeg.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libjbig.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libzstd.a repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libz.a -lm -lpthread -lrt -ldl -o /tmp/barcode_driver_asan && for f in /workspace/poc_*.spix; do echo ==== $f; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/barcode_driver_asan $f 2>&1 | head -100; done
